categories.name: sphere
categories.description: round particle: circular outline in projection, smooth curved boundary, no corners or straight edges

categories.name: cube
categories.description: cubic particle: square or slightly rectangular outline with four corners and straight edges

categories.name: rod
categories.description: elongated particle such as a rod, wire or needle: length at least ~2x the width, roughly parallel sides

categories.name: aggregate
categories.description: cluster of several smaller primary particles fused or touching: lumpy, irregular outline

categories.name: hexagonal
categories.description: hexagonal plate or prism: six straight edges and six corners in projection
